Packaging (binding, Intent default): OpenTUI's native renderer cannot be bundled into the platform-neutral holyagent.js, and neither the Claude plugin nor the Pi package ships node_modules (facts and paths in /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw94x3k2-3wq5.md). On first interactive use setup installs those packages, at the exact versions the build resolved from bun.lock (embedded by the build, so `mise run deps:update` keeps them current with no second pin table), into a HolyAgent-owned per-user cache (XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache on Linux and macOS, LOCALAPPDATA on Windows) with the Bun Shell, then imports the TUI from there. It falls back to the existing line-based flow, with one line saying why, when stdin or stdout is not a TTY, CI is set, TERM is dumb, --no-tui is passed, any choice flag is given, or the install or import fails (offline). Add @opentui/solid, @opentui/core and solid-js as caret-range devDependencies at their line boundary with bun.lock, as scripts/dependency-ranges.test.ts expects; pin solid-js at 1.9.16 or later.

Flags: one per choice (worktrees and device access, on or off) plus --no-tui, named in the existing CLI style, documented in the setup usage and notes and in docs/pi/t3-code.md. Flags skip the TUI and apply directly.
